# COMMAND ----------

# Read the CSV files
import pandas as pd

# Read training data
train_df = spark.read.csv("/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/${MLPAB_DATABRICKS_PREFIX}/features_train.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
serve_df = spark.read.csv("/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/${MLPAB_DATABRICKS_PREFIX}/features_serve.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)

# Convert to pandas for computation
train_pd = train_df.toPandas()
serve_pd = serve_df.toPandas()

# Compute mean and std (population) for each feature from training data only
features = ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']
means = train_pd[features].mean()
stds = train_pd[features].std(ddof=0)  # population std

# Standardize both splits
for feature in features:
    train_pd[feature] = ((train_pd[feature] - means[feature]) / stds[feature]).round(6)
    serve_pd[feature] = ((serve_pd[feature] - means[feature]) / stds[feature]).round(6)

# Add split column
train_pd['split'] = 'train'
serve_pd['split'] = 'serve'

# Combine both splits
combined_pd = pd.concat([train_pd, serve_pd], ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns: row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4
combined_pd = combined_pd[['row_id', 'split', 'f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']]

# Create Spark DataFrame
combined_df = spark.createDataFrame(combined_pd)

# Write to Unity Catalog table
catalog_schema = "${MLPAB_DATABRICKS_SCHEMA}"
combined_df.write.mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(f"{catalog_schema}.scaleda1a1c9")

# Register as feature table
from databricks.feature_store import FeatureStoreClient
fs = FeatureStoreClient()

# Create feature table
feature_table_name = f"{catalog_schema}.scaleda1a1c9"
fs.create_table(
    name=feature_table_name,
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=combined_df,
    description="Standardized features from training and serving splits"
)

# Publish for online access
fs.publish_table(feature_table_name)

# COMMAND ----------

from databricks.feature_store import FeatureStoreClient
import pandas as pd

# COMMAND ----------

prefix = "mlpab58867e"
user = "benedict@logicalclocks.com"

# Read the CSV files
train_df = spark.read.csv(f"/Workspace/Users/{user}/{prefix}/features_train.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
serve_df = spark.read.csv(f"/Workspace/Users/{user}/{prefix}/features_serve.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)

# COMMAND ----------

# Collect training data to compute statistics
train_local = train_df.collect()

# Compute mean and std for each feature
features = ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']
means = {}
stds = {}

for feature in features:
    values = [row[feature] for row in train_local]
    mean_val = sum(values) / len(values)
    std_val = (sum((x - mean_val) ** 2 for x in values) / len(values)) ** 0.5
    means[feature] = mean_val
    stds[feature] = std_val

print("Means:", means)
print("Std devs:", stds)

# COMMAND ----------

# Standardize the data using Spark
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit

# Add split column
train_df = train_df.withColumn("split", lit("train"))
serve_df = serve_df.withColumn("split", lit("serve"))

# Standardize features
for feature in features:
    mean_val = means[feature]
    std_val = stds[feature]
    train_df = train_df.withColumn(feature, ((col(feature) - lit(mean_val)) / lit(std_val)).cast("double"))
    serve_df = serve_df.withColumn(feature, ((col(feature) - lit(mean_val)) / lit(std_val)).cast("double"))

# COMMAND ----------

# Round to 6 decimals
from pyspark.sql.functions import round as spark_round

for feature in features:
    train_df = train_df.withColumn(feature, spark_round(col(feature), 6))
    serve_df = serve_df.withColumn(feature, spark_round(col(feature), 6))

# COMMAND ----------

# Union both splits
combined_df = train_df.unionByName(serve_df)

# Select columns in order: row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4
combined_df = combined_df.select("row_id", "split", "f1", "f2", "f3", "f4")

# COMMAND ----------

# Write to Unity Catalog table
catalog_schema = "workspace.mlpab58867e"
table_name = "scaleda1a1c9"
full_table_name = f"{catalog_schema}.{table_name}"

# Save as managed table
combined_df.write.mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(full_table_name)

# COMMAND ----------

# Register as feature table
fs = FeatureStoreClient()

# Create feature table
fs.create_table(
    name=full_table_name,
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=combined_df,
    description="Standardized features from training and serving splits"
)

# COMMAND ----------

# Publish for online access
fs.publish_table(full_table_name)

# COMMAND ----------

import pandas as pd
from databricks.feature_store import FeatureStoreClient

# COMMAND ----------

# Read the CSV files from workspace
prefix = "mlpab58867e"
user = "benedict@logicalclocks.com"

# Read training data
train_path = f"/Workspace/Users/{user}/{prefix}/features_train.csv"
serve_path = f"/Workspace/Users/{user}/{prefix}/features_serve.csv"

train_df = spark.read.csv(train_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
serve_df = spark.read.csv(serve_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)

# Convert to pandas for computation
train_pd = train_df.toPandas()
serve_pd = serve_df.toPandas()

# COMMAND ----------

# Compute mean and std (population) for each feature from training data only
features = ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']
means = train_pd[features].mean()
stds = train_pd[features].std(ddof=0)  # population std

print("Means:", means.to_dict())
print("Std devs:", stds.to_dict())

# COMMAND ----------

# Standardize both splits
for feature in features:
    train_pd[feature] = ((train_pd[feature] - means[feature]) / stds[feature]).round(6)
    serve_pd[feature] = ((serve_pd[feature] - means[feature]) / stds[feature]).round(6)

# Add split column
train_pd['split'] = 'train'
serve_pd['split'] = 'serve'

# Combine both splits
combined_pd = pd.concat([train_pd, serve_pd], ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns: row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4
combined_pd = combined_pd[['row_id', 'split', 'f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']]

# Create Spark DataFrame
combined_df = spark.createDataFrame(combined_pd)

# COMMAND ----------

# Write to Unity Catalog table
catalog_schema = "workspace.mlpab58867e"
table_name = "scaleda1a1c9"
full_table_name = f"{catalog_schema}.{table_name}"

# Save as managed table in Unity Catalog
combined_df.write.mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(full_table_name)

# COMMAND ----------

# Register as feature table with version 1
fs = FeatureStoreClient()

# Create the feature table
fs.create_table(
    name=full_table_name,
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=combined_df,
    description="Standardized features from training and serving splits"
)

# COMMAND ----------

# Publish for online access
fs.publish_table(full_table_name)
EOF
